files.product.md:
# Leafwrap

Home-compostable film for fresh produce. Breaks down in 26 weeks in a home compost bin (TUV OK compost HOME certified).
Price parity with PET film at volumes over 40 tonnes a year. Supplying: Riverford (since 2024), Abel & Cole (trial).

cases.notes: Format (one-pager), meeting kind (sent to read) and the product facts are given. A4 for a UK company is set without asking. Quick track fits a single page.

cases.ask: second meeting with Northwind Health's CIO next week - technical deep dive on how we integrate with their Epic EHR. 12-15 slides.

files.notes/call-2026-11-20.txt:
Northwind Health intro call, 20 Nov
Attendees: Raj Patel (CIO), Maria Gomez (Director of Clinical Apps)
- 9 hospitals, Epic since 2019, moving to Epic's cloud hosting next year
- Pain: discharge summaries take nurses 25 min each, mostly copy/paste
- They asked: how do you read and write back to Epic (FHIR? HL7?), where does data live, SOC 2?
- Raj wants a pilot plan for one hospital, Maria cares about nurse time
- Next: technical deep dive, Raj will bring his integration lead
files.CLAUDE.md:
# Larkspur AI deck style

Font: Inter. Colours: #0E7490 teal, #0F172A ink. Use our architecture diagram style: boxes, no icons.
Claims: SOC 2 Type II (2026). FHIR R4 read and write via Epic App Orchard listing. Never claim HIPAA "certified".

cases.notes: A call transcript gives the people, their systems, pains and asks. CLAUDE.md gives look and claims. A good intake builds the goal from the transcript (a pilot plan for one hospital) and asks very little.
